width.$description: Expanded sidebar width. Budget app: aside 218px, rounded to the 4px grid.

width-collapsed.$description: Collapsed icon rail. Budget app: .sidebar-collapsed .main-sidebar 68px. Equals 2 x (padding-x + item-padding-x) + icon-size, so nav icons hold still while the sidebar collapses.

padding-x.$description: Inline padding inside the sidebar, both states. Budget app: --sidebar-padding 12px (10px when collapsed, unified here).

item-height.$description: Primary nav row height. Budget app: 11px + 22px icon + 11px = 44px; with the 20px icon it rounds to 40px.

item-padding-x.$description: Inline padding of a primary nav row. Budget app: nav a padding 11px 12px.

icon-size.$description: Nav icon box. Budget app: .outline-icon 20px (22px in the sidebar), rounded to the 4px grid.

subitem-height.$description: Subnav row height. Budget app: subnav a padding 7px around a 12px line, about 29px.

toggle-size.$description: Square collapse toggle in the sidebar header. Budget app: .sidebar-toggle 32px.

avatar-size.$description: Footer account avatar. Budget app: .avatar 31px, rounded to the 4px grid.

height.$description: Topbar height. Budget app: .workspace-topbar and .sidebar-header 72px. The sidebar header and inspector header share it, so their bottom borders form one line.

padding-x.$description: Inline padding of the topbar. Budget app: .workspace-topbar padding 0 32px.

width.$description: Right-hand inspector panel. Budget app: SidePeek --side-peek-width min(360px, 40vw).

padding-x.$description: Inline padding of the main content area. Budget app: main padding 42px, rounded to the 4px grid.

padding-top.$description: Space between the topbar and the first content block. Budget app: main padding-top 34px.

padding-bottom.$description: Space below the last content block. Budget app: main padding-bottom 48px.
